title: Training-point consistency of kernel ridge regression with varying correlation scales
abstract: arXiv:2611.18095v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The scale parameter in kernel ridge regression plays a pivotal role in modeling the correlation structure of data. In modern applications, sampling density and the underlying correlation range often change simultaneously, making a fixed-scale assumption highly restrictive. However, establishing asymptotic theories under varying scale parameters is fundamentally challenging. To address this gap, this paper develops a unified theoretical framework for kernel ridge regression under varying scale parameters. We establish that, on uniform tensor grids with product exponential kernels, the consistency of the training-point risk holds if and only if the effective local sample size diverges to infinity. This sharp criterion universally covers all regimes along arbitrary deterministic scale sequences, seamlessly unifying the long-range, fixed-scale, and short-range. translated_title: 相关尺度变化下核岭回归的训练点一致性
translated_abstract: 核岭回归中的尺度参数在建模数据的相关结构方面起着关键作用。在现代应用中，采样密度与潜在的相关范围往往同时发生变化，这使得固定尺度的假设具有很强的局限性。然而，在变化的尺度参数下建立渐近理论从根本上是具有挑战性的。为填补这一空白，本文为变化尺度参数下的核岭回归建立了一个统一的理论框架。我们证明，在带有乘积指数核的均匀张量网格上，训练点风险的一致性成立当且仅当有效局部样本量发散到无穷大。这一判据覆盖了任意确定性尺度序列下的所有情形，无缝统一了长程、固定尺度和短程等各种情形。此外，我们还提供了一个显式的、与信号无关的确定性构造……
tldr: 本文建立了变化尺度参数下核岭回归的统一理论框架，证明训练点风险的一致性当且仅当有效局部样本量发散到无穷大，从而无缝统一了长程、固定尺度和短程等各种情形。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a unified theoretical framework for kernel ridge regression under varying scale parameters, proving that training-point risk consistency holds if and only if the effective local sample size diverges to infinity, seamlessly unifying the long-range, fixed-scale, and short-range regimes.
